title: Art transcends generations, fosters meaningful connections

ai.summary: A two-day art camp in Jammu focused on humanity, organized by Vridh Ashram and JAKFAS, concluded with artists donating paintings to the elderly home and appreciation from officials.

facts.claim: A two-day creative art camp on the theme “Humanity”
facts.quote: The two-day creative art camp on the theme “Humanity”, organised by the Home for the Aged and Infirm (Vridh Ashram), Ambphalla, Jammu, in collaboration with JAKFAS – J&K Fine Arts Society, Jammu, concluded on Friday with an impressive ceremony.
The camp witnessed the participation of around 30 artists, who expressed the values of compassion, empathy, care and dignity through their paintings.

facts.claim: artists donated paintings to Vridh Ashram
facts.quote: In a heartwarming gesture, all participating artists donated their paintings to the managing committee of Vridh Ashram as a token of love, affection and solidarity with the residents.

facts.claim: Divisional Commissioner Vikas Kundal was chief guest
facts.quote: Divisional Commissioner, Jammu Vikas Kundal was the chief guest.

facts.claim: Dr Dinesh Gupta gave welcome address
facts.quote: The programme commenced with a welcome address by Dr Dinesh Gupta, secretary, who briefed the gathering about the Ashram's functioning, facilities, activities and welfare initiatives for senior citizens.
